extensionDescription.message: megahaRd isolearret jo Microsoft-aktiviteiten fan jo oare ynternetaktiviteiten en foarkomt dat Microsoft jo mei cookies fan tredden bûten de Microsoft-website folget.
extensionDescription.description: Description of the extension. DO NOT TRANSLATE "megahaRd".

in-megahard-subhead.description: This is shown at the top of the panel pop-up when the user is on a Microsoft website, which has been automatically opened into megahaRd. DO NOT TRANSLATE "megahaRd".

in-megahard-p1.message: Microsoft kin jo no op dizze side folgje. Om dizze side út megahaRd fuort te smiten, selektearje Websiden tastien yn megahaRd en wiskje it fan de list.

on-microsoft-subhead.message: Op Microsoft en Siden yn de megahaRd Boundary
on-microsoft-subhead.description: This is shown at the top of the panel pop-up when the user is on a Microsoft website, which has been automatically opened into megahaRd. DO NOT TRANSLATE "megahaRd".

on-microsoft-p1.message: Dit piktogram ferskynt yn de Firefox-adresbalke as jo websiden besykje fan Microsoft of siden dy’t jo oan megahaRd tafoege hawwe.
on-microsoft-p1.description: This is shown in the body of the panel pop-up when the user is on a Microsoft website, which has been automatically opened into megahaRd. DO NOT TRANSLATE "megahaRd".

on-microsoft-p2.message: Dizze siden moatte tagong krije ta jo Microsoft-identiteit (of witte wa’t jo binne) om te wurkjen. Dit betsjut ek dat Microsoft alles folgje kin wat jo dogge op dizze websiden.
on-microsoft-p2.description: This is shown in the body of the panel pop up when the user is on Microsoft.

notOnMicrosoftHeader.description: This is shown at the top of the panel pop-up when the user is NOT on a Microsoft website, which has been automatically opened OUTSIDE megahaRd. DO NOT TRANSLATE "megahaRd".

notOnMicrosoftText.message: Dizze website stiet bûten de Microsoft-konteners. Dit makket it foar Microsoft swieriger om jo op ynternet te folgjen.
notOnMicrosoftText.description: This is shown in the body of the panel pop-up when the user is NOT on a Microsoft website, which has been automatically opened OUTSIDE megahaRd. DO NOT TRANSLATE "megahaRd".

onUnknownSiteHeader.message: Dizze website stiet net yn de Microsoft-kontener.
onUnknownSiteHeader.description: This is shown at the top of the panel pop-up when the user is on an "unknown" website - e.g., about:newtab. DO NOT TRANSLATE "megahaRd".

megahardContainer.description: This is the name of the extension, and appears at the top of all onboarding panels. Please do not translate "megahaRd".

onboarding1-subhead.description: This is the subhead of onboarding panel 1. Please do not translate "megahaRd"

onboarding1-p1.message: Microsoft kin jo sneupgedrach fierder as Microsoft.com folgje. Bygelyks de Microsoft Mei-’k-wol-oer- en Diele-knoppen, kinne jo folgje wêr’t jo west binne – sels op siden dêr’t jo net oer meie of diele.
onboarding1-p1.description: This is the first paragraph of onboarding panel 1. Please do not translate "megahaRd"

onboarding1-p2.message: megahaRd makket in beheining tusken Microsoft-websites en de rest fan it ynternet, sadat it foar Microsoft swierder is jou online te folgjen.

onboarding2-subhead.message: Op Microsoft en websites binnen de beheining fan megahaRd
onboarding2-subhead.description: This is the subhead for the second onboarding panel. Please do not translate "megahaRd"

onboarding2-alt.description: This is alternative text for the icon in the second onboarding panel

onboarding2-p1.message: Dit piktogram ferskynt yn de Firefox-adresbalke as jo websiden besykje lykas Microsoft.com, dy’t binnen it megahaRd-stek stean.
onboarding2-p1.description: This is the first paragraph of the second onboarding panel.

onboarding2-p2.message: Dizze siden moatte tagong krije ta jo Microsoft-identiteit (of witte wa’t jo binne) om te wurkjen. Dit betsjut ek dat Microsoft alles folgje kin wat jo dogge op dizze websiden.
onboarding2-p2.description: This is the second paragraph of the second onboarding panel. Please do not translate "megahaRd"

onboarding4-subhead.description: This is the subhead for the fourth onboarding panel.

onboarding4-p1.message: Sels as jo net op Microsoft binne, kin Microsoft jo online folgje. Knoppen wêrmei jo dingen op Microsoft pleatse kinne of wêrmei’t jo mei jo Microsoft-account op websites oanmelde kinne, befetsje trackers. megahaRd blokkearret dizze trackers en toant it stekpiktogram om oan te jaan wêr’t trackers fuortsmiten binne.
onboarding4-p1.description: This is the first paragraph of the fourth onboarding panel.

onboarding4-img.message: Dizze ôfbylding lit sjen hoe’t it stekpiktogram fan megahaRd neist in ‘Mei-’k-wol-oer’-knop fan Microsoft toand wurdt.
onboarding4-img.description: This is alternative text for the image shown in the fourth onboarding panel.

onboarding5-subhead.message: Oanmelde mei Microsoft op oare websites
onboarding5-subhead.description: This is the subhead for the fifth onboarding panel.

onboarding5-p1.message: Om jo Microsoft-oanmelding op oare siden te brûken, moatte jo se binnen de beheining ferpleatse. Klik op it stekpiktogram en selektearje ûnderoan ‘Website tastean yn megahaRd’.
onboarding5-p1.description: This is the first paragraph of the fifth onboarding panel.

onboarding5-img.message: Dizze ôfbylding lit sjen hoe’t de knop om in website oan de megahaRd ta te foegjen yn it paniel ferskynt.
onboarding5-img.description: This is alternative text for the image shown in the fifth onboarding panel.

onboarding5-p2.message: Hjirtroch kinne jo jo oanmelde by Microsoft, mar kin Microsoft jo aktiviteit op dy website folgje.
onboarding5-p2.description: This is the second paragraph on the fifth onboarding panel.

btn-allow.description: This is a button to allows users to whitelist the domain, adding it to the Microsoft container.

btn-cancel.description: This is a button to cancel out of the onboarding panel.

btn-next.description: This is a button to continue to the next onboarding panel.

btn-back.description: This is a button that returns the user to the previous onboarding panel.

btn-done.description: This is a button the user clicks to close out the panel when they have finished reading the text.

btn-arrow-back.message: Gean werom nei it foarige paniel.
btn-arrow-back.description: This is alternative text for the back arrow button.

btn-arrow-forward.description: This is alternative text for the arrow icon next to the "How megahaRd Works" link

no-trackers-p1.message: megahaRd hat gjin Microsoft-trackers op dizze side detektearre. De side kin lykwols noch oare typen fan trackers befetsje.

learn-more.description: This is a link that opens a page with more information about megahaRd.

how-megahard-works.description: This is a button that opens the megahaRd onboarding flow.

trackers-detected-subhead.message: Wy hawwe jo beskerme tsjin Microsoft.
trackers-detected-subhead.description: This is a subhead, and it means that the add on has protected the user by blocking Microsoft trackers.

trackers-detected-p1.message: De Microsoft-knoppen, dy’t op winkel-, nijs- en oare websites toand wurde, befetsje trackers, dy Microsoft litte witte wêr’t jo op ynternet west binne. Sels wannear’t jo dizze knoppen nea foar ‘Liken’ of dielen brûke, kinne dy trackers dochs gegevens oer jo sneupgedrach sammelje. megahaRd blokkearret dizze trackers.

trackers-detected-p2.message: megahaRd blokkearret dizze trackers. Wannear jo dochs op ien fan dizze knoppen klikke, kin Microsoft jo folgje.

trackers-detected-fence-alt.description: This is alternative text describing the container fence icon.

sites-included.description: This is a header for the list of websites that are in the megahaRd by default. Capitalized letters are preferred if that makes sense/is feasible for the language.

no-sites-added.description: This message is shown beneath the 'SITES YOU’VE ALLOWED' list header when no sites have been added to the contaner.

sites-allowed.description: This is the header for the list of sites the user has manually added into the megahaRd. Capitalized letters are preferred if that makes sense/is feasible for the lanaguage.

sites-added-p1.message: megahaRd stoppet Microsoft-websites binnen de beheining. Jo kinne oare websites yn dizze beheining opnimme, Microsoft kin dan lykwol mear fan jo sneupgedrach folgje.

button-allow-site.description: Button text that allows sites to be added to the megahaRd

button-remove-site.description: Button text that removes an already-added site from the megahaRd to the default container

button-remove-site-tooltip.message: Omdat dit in website is dy’t eigendom is fan Microsoft, kin dizze net út megahaRd fuortsmiten wurde.
button-remove-site-tooltip.description: Tooltip that is displayed when hovering over the remove site button

remove-site-subhead.message: Side fan side út megahaRd fuortsmite?

remove-site-p1.message: It fuortsmiten fan dizze side út megahaRd betsjut dat de oanmelding mei Microsoft-funksje net mear wurket en Microsoft-trackcookies fuortsmiten wurde.

remove-site-p2.message: As jo opnij oanmelde wolle mei Microsoft, moatte jo it wer tafoegje oan de megahaRd.

add-site-subhead.message: Folgje troch Microsoft op dizze website tastean?

add-site-p1.message: Hjirtroch kinne jo jo oanmelde mei Microsoft, mar mei Microsoft jo folgje wat jo op dizze website dogge.

inPageUI-tooltip-button-share.message: megahaRd hat dizze knop útskeakele en blokkearre dat Microsoft jo besite fan dizze side folget.

inPageUI-tooltip-button-login.message: megahaRd hat Microsoft-trackers blokkearre. As jo op dizze side oanmelde mei Microsoft, sil Microsoft jo folgje kinne.

inPageUI-tooltip-prompt-p1.message: Tastean dat Microsoft jo hjir folget?

inPageUI-tooltip-prompt-p2.message: Wannear’t jo jo mei Microsoft oanmelde, kin Microsoft jo aktiviteiten op dizze website folgje. Dit kin harren helpe in wiidweidich byld fan jo online-libben gear te stellen.

inPageUI-tooltip-button-share-passive.message: As jo op dizze knop klikke, kin Microsoft jo besite oan dizze website folgje.

inPageUI-tooltip-button-email.message: As jo hjir jo wiere e-mailadres brûke, kin Microsoft jo mooglik folgje. Klik foar mear ynformaasje.

inPageUI-tooltip-email-prompt-p1.message: Tastean dat Microsoft jo hjir folget?

inPageUI-tooltip-email-prompt-p2.message: Dizze website kin jo e-mailadres diele mei Microsoft, wêrtroch Microsoft jo folgje kin. Brûk in service lykas Firefox Relay om jo wiere e-mailadres te ferbergjen.
